title: At School
summary: Two students talk about their favourite school subjects, teachers, and break-time activities.
description: A short classroom-themed dialogue that recycles school vocabulary: subjects, teachers, classrooms, break, lunch. Useful as the first lesson of a new school year.

vocabulary.definition: a topic you study at school, like math or history
the adult who teaches you at school
a short time between lessons when you can relax
the room where you have lessons

dialogue.text: What is your favourite subject, Lily?
I like art. My art teacher is very nice. What about you?
I really like science. The teacher is funny.
It is on the second floor. And yours?
Mine is on the first floor, next to the library.
Do you have a long break?
Yes, we have a fifteen-minute break at ten o'clock.

trueFalse.explanation: Lily says she likes art. The speaker likes science.

trueFalse.statement: The break is at ten o'clock.
trueFalse.explanation: Lily says 'we have a fifteen-minute break at ten o'clock.'

teacherTips: Pre-teach the names of school subjects with flashcards before listening.
After listening, students rank the subjects mentioned from 'most useful' to 'most fun' in pairs.
Extension: learners ask and answer 'What is your favourite subject?' around the class.

es.title: En la escuela
es.summary: Dos estudiantes hablan de sus asignaturas favoritas, sus profesores y las actividades del recreo.
es.description: Un diálogo corto sobre el colegio que recicla vocabulario escolar: asignaturas, profesores, aulas, recreo, almuerzo. Útil como primera clase de un nuevo curso.

vocabulary.definition: un tema que estudias en la escuela, como matemáticas o historia
el adulto que te enseña en la escuela
un tiempo corto entre clases para descansar
la sala donde tienes las clases

questions.q: ¿Cuál es la asignatura favorita de Lily?

trueFalse.statement: A Lily le gustan las ciencias.
trueFalse.explanation: Lily dice que le gusta el arte. Al interlocutor le gustan las ciencias.

trueFalse.statement: El recreo es a las diez.
trueFalse.explanation: Lily dice 'we have a fifteen-minute break at ten o'clock'.

teacherTips: Enseña antes los nombres de las asignaturas con tarjetas.
Después de escuchar, los estudiantes ordenan las asignaturas mencionadas de 'más útil' a 'más divertida' por parejas.
Ampliación: los estudiantes preguntan y responden 'What is your favourite subject?' por la clase.
